newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas announced that the issue of hydrochloroflourocarbons (HCFCs) will not be discussed during Wednesday's Commission meeting and is postponed to the following week.

Van der Pas confirmed that the Volkswagen dispute would be discussed at the meeting. He said Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert would hold a news conference on the issue at 1215/1015 GMT on Wednesday.

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said he would brief on the meeting between European Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan and Stuart Eizenstat, U.S. Under-Secretary for Trade and U.S. President Bill Clinton's special envoy on the Helms-Burton Cuban trade restrictions, at 1630/1430 GMT on Tuesday.
In answer to a question, Vale de Almeida said any decision on further action in the World Trade Organisation over the Cuba dispute would be in October.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/815: Public procurement: Commission publishes common procurement vocabulary for contracts.
- Speech/96/203: European Commissioner Emma Bonino - speech for the European Consumer Forum - "The consumer & information society" - Dublin Castle 3rd-4th September 1996.
- European Economy No 7 - July 1996 - Supplement A - Mergers and acquisitions.
- Social Europe 2/95 - Social dialogue - The situation in the Community in 1995.
- Community Social Policy - Programmes, networks and observatories.
